name: elywalk
description: Compteur de pas minimaliste via Health Connect / HealthKit (Capacitor)

scripts.cap:sync: npm run build && npx cap sync
scripts.cap:android: npm run build && npx cap sync android && npx cap open android
scripts.apk:debug: npm run build && npx cap sync android && cd android && ./gradlew assembleDebug
scripts.apk:release: npm run build && npx cap sync android && cd android && ./gradlew assembleRelease
